desc:
🎮 Inspired by the hit Netflix series Squid Game

⭐ Don’t forget to like the game if you enjoy it!

Step into a world of intense mini-games where every round tests your skill, timing, and courage. Only the smartest players make it to the end!

✨ Season 1 Games
Red Light, Green Light
Honeycomb
Lights Out
Tug of War
Marbles
Glass Steppingstones
Squid Game

✨ Season 2 / 3 Games
Red Light, Green Light
Jump Rope
Lights Out
Pentathlon
Mingle
Rebellion


⚠️ Do you have what it takes to survive every challenge?
Win the games, outlast the competition, and prove you’re the ultimate survivor!
